[SWS_EthIf_00682] Report of a link state change towards the EthSM and config-
ured users for an EthIfController that acts independent of a MACsec opera-
tional state
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00033, FO_RS_MACsec_00002
⌈If EthIf detects a link state change either as sole link state or as accumulated link state
and the following conditions are valid:
• an affected EthIfController references no MkaPaeInstance,
• this affected EthIfController references either an EthIfTransceiver or
an EthIfSwitch or an EthIfSwitchPortGroup
then EthIf shall store the link state for this EthIfController and report the link state
change by calling the following APIs with the changed link state (either ETHTRCV_
LINK_STATE_ACTIVE or ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_DOWN ):
• call EthSM_TrcvLinkStateChg with CtrlIdx set to the affected EthIfCon-
troller and TransceiverLinkState set to changed link state
• call <User>_TrcvLinkStateChg for all configured users with CtrlIdx set to
the affected EthIfController and TransceiverLinkState set to changed
link state
⌋
Link state changes that refer to MACsec protected Ethernet hardware entities (either
PHY or Ethernet switch port) are always immediately reported to the key agreement
module to support fast processing (e.g. fast start up for MACsec protected communi-
cation).
